# stele-context

Local context cache for coding agents. Version 2.3.0 is a std-only Rust binary. The old Python 1.x version lives on the python-legacy branch and on PyPI (1.5.x).

Install: GitHub Release assets for v2.3.0, or scripts/install.sh and scripts/install.ps1.
Commands: doctor, index, detect, search, query, agent-grep, find-definition, find-references.
MCP: stele-context serve-mcp. Default mode is lite. Set STELE_MCP_MODE=standard or full.
No embedding model is bundled. Summaries and vectors are supplied by the caller.
